Have you ever had a day when you just wanted to play something and not using your brain too much? If the answer is [b]yes[/b] then good news for you. EDF5 is a game you're looking for.
[b]EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5[/b] is an arcade shooter game. You do not have to worry about ammo, it's unlimited (but you still need to reload) and you shoot down aliens which looks like ants, frogs or spiders (so if you have arachnofobia, you better rember that). There are ultiple types of enemies and that's great since the game has 111 lvls. So it's immposibble to get bored.
I'll go straight to the best part: [b]co-op[/b]. EDF is godlike when you have friends to play with. Max players in a sesion is 4 but that's more that enough. After all while fighting everything you see is pure chaos.
When it comes to [b]grapics[/b], hmm.... At first it looks like nothing special but the more you play, the more lvls you play, the more details you'll see. Like shop interiors, or road signs... It makes it feel more [b]real[/b].
[b]Music[/b]. Can't say much about it... The only ones worth remembering are victory sounds. They're very rewarding.
[b]Gameplay[/b]. You run. You shoot. You pick up loot. Nice, easy, realaxing. [u]Exept that you have 5 dificulites levels, hundreds of weapons and 4 classes to choose from[/u]. That makes [b]EDF[/b] a game with impossible high replayability. So you can sink in here thousants of hours even after finishing...
[b]The story[/b]. Yup, this game have a story. I'd say it's one of [i][u]What? Oh I... No, wait.[/u][/i] kind. Just classic: aliens attacked, kill them. But who would care for it in a arcade game? I'd say... everyone? Story has both military pathos and some humor smashed together. It's like watching a B class movie. I like it.
EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5 is an awesome game.
I'd recomend it any time now. 
Time to go. Need to prepare for a next game in the series! Enjoy your fight
From now on, we will not wonder if this game is pure fun. We will assume it.

First timer to the series and must say this really gets my musou rocks off. I remember going crazy during ps2 or whatever era with samurai warriors with my mates for hours on end. This is an even greater experience considering co-operation and planning can mean the difference between great success and utter failure. This is the perfect game for those that like killing 100 enemies per minute(or 1 bad-ass for 5 minutes) whilst actually having to have to strategise with your party.

There are 4 different classes with each honestly near hundreds of different weapons(per class) providing different proprieties allowing you to kill the alien menace which ever way you could ever dream off. Nukes, Gatling, Plasma cannons, rockets, airstrikes, Javelins, sword, simple military munitions. EDF is your oyster to explore pure destruction upon your enemies.

I'm not joking about the weapons. Most aren't just lvl5 of the weapon you picked up long ago. Sometimes you'll find "weaker" lower level weapons would fair you better in a conflict scenario than others.

Scenarios! Base game provides you with 100+ lvls. The way these crafty nipponese have designed it is so that it'll be a constant addiction of new and upgraded enemies bringing various different gifts to the battlefield. As they evolve you'll obviously too. As you gain new powers and abilities broadening the scope of which you'll have to engage any situation these alien scum may bring. You'll find the battlefield your enemy too. As the terrain itself will pressure you to take on enemies you've fought and maimed before from another angle. 

The thing, The game gives you all the tools to freely express yourself as a fighter and a teammate. Many game devs might strive for such. But EDF nails it!
